fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (thousands): 161,791 for FY2014 per item7 statistical table.

instrument_type_details.notes: Instruments: Fixed Forward Price contracts (FFPs), forward swaps, call options for crude oil, collar contracts for heating oil. At Dec 31, 2014: 27% of next 12 months' fuel hedged at ~$2.51/gal (in excess of market prices). All existing contracts expected to settle by end of Q2 2015. Net fair value = -$27.1M (liability), offset by $14.4M margin call deposits, net overall liability = $12.7M. At Dec 31, 2013: net fair value was $2.4M (asset). 10% price increase sensitivity: +$17.8M fuel expense.
